sampling.method: Half the largest absolute change from the stored minimum to an adjacent sampled pose, plus 0.0005 mm for rounding.

no_requirement.finger_a|finger_b: TPU gripping surfaces intentionally meet below contact angle; pad interference is checked separately.
no_requirement.finger_a|fsr_backing_b: The grip closes onto the backed sensor; compliant-pad contact is intended.
no_requirement.finger_a|fsr_puck_b: The grip closes onto the sensor puck; compliant-pad contact is intended.
no_requirement.finger_a|fsr_sensor_b: The grip closes onto the sensor; compliant-pad contact is intended.
no_requirement.horn|servo: The bought horn seats on the servo spline and output boss.
no_requirement.nail_a|finger_b: The nail presses cloth against the compliant finger in service.
no_requirement.nail_a|fsr_backing_b: The nail presses against the backed FSR stack in service.
no_requirement.nail_a|fsr_puck_b: The nail presses against the FSR puck in service.
no_requirement.nail_a|fsr_sensor_b: The nail presses against the FSR sensor in service.
no_requirement.fasteners_a|servo: No design-basis row assigns a clearance for this dog-fastener gap.
no_requirement.horn|fasteners: No whole-solid clearance minimum is assigned to the horn centre fastener.
no_requirement.finger_a|front_plate: Separated moving finger and fixed plate; no adjacent assembly fit is defined.
no_requirement.finger_a|housing: Separated moving finger and fixed housing; no adjacent assembly fit is defined.
no_requirement.finger_b|front_plate: Separated moving finger and fixed plate; no adjacent assembly fit is defined.
no_requirement.finger_b|housing: Separated moving finger and fixed housing; no adjacent assembly fit is defined.
no_requirement.horn|knuckle_b: The horn drives knuckle A; no direct interface exists with knuckle B.
no_requirement.knuckle_a|servo: The knuckle is separated from the servo case by the housing and horn stack.
no_requirement.knuckle_b|wrist_mount: The knuckle and wrist mount have no adjacent interface.
no_requirement.knuckle_b|servo: The knuckle and servo case have no adjacent interface.
no_requirement.fasteners_a|knuckle_b: Side-A hardware has no intended interface with knuckle B.
no_requirement.knuckle_a|fasteners_b: Knuckle A has no intended interface with side-B hardware.
no_requirement.fasteners_b|servo: Side-B hardware has no adjacent interface with the servo case.

B4.disposition: Grade the drawn bore at assembly. It sits exactly at the band top (margin -1.8e-17 mm); redrawing it changes no fit outcome.

T07.feature: gear backlash jt, circumferential, 2 d / cos(alpha) from the mesh gap d, alpha from params.json gear.pressure_angle
